list.name: status
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM print_jobs ORDER BY status

list.name: material
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(filament_type, 'Unknown') FROM print_jobs ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom()
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETE')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom()
SELECT ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_seconds) / 3600, 1) as hours FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND start_time > $__timeFrom()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'PRINTING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'PRINTING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN actual_duration_seconds < 3600 THEN '<1h' WHEN actual_duration_seconds < 7200 THEN '1-2h' WHEN actual_duration_seconds < 14400 THEN '2-4h' ELSE '4h+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_seconds) / 3600, 2) AS avg_hours FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT filename, status, ROUND(actual_duration_seconds / 60.0) AS duration_min, ROUND(filament_used_g) AS filament_g, ROUND((COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric, 2) AS total_cost, start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth' AS started FROM print_jobs ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 25
